name: DC 311 service requests
insights: Measures who calls, not what is broken: call propensity tracks tenure, age and civic engagement, so never compare request volume between neighborhoods — you would be measuring the population, not the potholes. Volume collapses at weekends, so any partial-week rate comparison is invalid on day-of-week composition alone
notes: Has a usable ZIP field; a good weekly signal

name: MPD crime incident data
traps: Police Service Area boundaries do not match ZIP boundaries — report counts by PSA and disclose the mismatch; long where-clauses intermittently return 403, so retry once
insights: Preliminary and subject to reclassification: figures drift for weeks after publication, so a re-query of a printed window will not match what was printed — that drift is late reporting and reclassification, never "the agency changed its numbers"

name: Open Data DC portal
traps: A single citywide portal covers what would be split between city and county elsewhere
insights: ArcGIS Hub rather than Socrata, so queries use FeatureServer syntax and the date-literal dialect must be discovered by execution rather than read from documentation
notes: Catalog hub for most DC agency datasets
